name: Talking to Boop always gets a face and a reply, kind or hurt
case: The person holds Boop's button and says something while an agent works. Boop can't talk back in words, but it always answers with a face and a reply: proud and puffed up at praise, hurt and flinching at an insult, and for a question about the tests the status reply, the facts on a sign rather than a guessed yes. It never stays quiet when spoken to.
why: PERSONALITY: when the person talks to Boop it always answers with a face and a reply, never none, and its Examples give each; ReactOutput's replies: praise is thanks, an insult ouch, a question about the agents status. What you said always wakes the brain
